cohort_rule: source_percentile >= 0.90 using frozen within-source-season x position average-rank percentile

support_classification_rule.purpose: presentation/evidence label only; not a model input or route selector
support_classification_rule.governed_route_cell_rule: eligible only if >=20 evaluation rows in each early/mid/validation block and >=4 distinct source seasons
support_classification_rule.well_supported: route cell meets governed support rule AND current Y1 standard source points <= frozen selection-window active top-decile p90 for same position/career stage
support_classification_rule.limited: route cell meets governed support rule AND current source points are > p90 but <= observed active top-decile max for same position/career stage
support_classification_rule.extrapolative: route cell fails governed support rule OR current source points exceed observed active top-decile max for same position/career stage
support_classification_rule.cohort_size_reporting: active top-decile N is always reported separately; no new sample-size threshold is introduced.
